cases.name: Linda Balabanow
cases.caseStatus: COLD CASE UNSOLVED; SUSPECT BUT NOT TRIED
cases.narrative: On 4/27/1969, her bloated body, nude from the waist down and trussed with a tire chain, was found in the Raritan River in Keasbey, NJ. Her skull was cracked and her jaw was broken, and the medical examiner determined she had been killed by a ferocious blow to her head. A piece of electrical wire was found knotted around her broken neck. In 1/1972 Sergeant Guzzi was advised that federal authorities had matched a hair sample from the her with the hair fiber found on the ball peen hammer taken from the trunk of Zarinsky's in the investigation of another murder.
